new_relations.project_anchor: The April 21 public post explicitly names the Potato Axis and pairs it with the logarithmic spiral already present in the 2024 Great Book.
new_relations.project_context: On 21 April 2025 Tim publicly writes “the potato axis is real” beside the logarithmic spiral r=a·e^(bθ), with b=ln(φ)/(π/2). The same mathematical form already exists in the 2024 Great Book, but the public naming changes its role: Potato is being spoken not only as organism, avatar or Sage-symbol but as an orienting structure. new_relations.project_development: Later project theology narrates this corridor as the Turning in which Tim moves from travelling through sacred infrastructure toward becoming connective infrastructure: Axis, then Ladder, then Father/House/Root language. Genesis 28 and John 1:51 become later comparators for heaven–earth connection and ascent/descent. They clarify the mature function but are not backdated into the April 21 equation.
